newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares rebound by close, seen down slightly.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares rebound by close, seen down slightly.

text.p: Polish shares rose 0.4 percent after a three-session fall but analysts said the market should ease on Thursday amid macroeconomic and election uncertainties.

Poland's parliamentary elections are due on September 21 while expected government borrowing from the central bank to pay for flood damage has heightened concerns of higher deficits, inflation and rates which would limit share-buying.

"(Tuesday's) data that broad money rose (2.8 percent in July's first 10 days) not considering money from loans given to the government is a factor suggesting we can have an inflation wave," said Roman Sosnowski of WBK-AIB Asset Management.
